item.title: Unity Voxel Engine #0: Binary Greedy Meshing from Scratch
item.description: Ever since my adventure with gamedev began, voxels were always my favorite subject. Vast open worlds with infinite possibilities kept teasing my curiosity – how is it all made? How do games like Minecraft render enormous chunks of terrain without grinding to a halt?
